Why should I enroll in this Learning & Development Certification Program?


AIHR’s online Learning & Development Certificate Program equips you with the learning and development skills to design impactful strategies, close skills gaps, create effective learning experiences, and use analytics to measure and communicate results. Graduates have applied these competencies to build successful L&D strategies at organizations such as Meta, Henkel, and P&G. Upon completion, you’ll earn a digital certificate to showcase your expertise.


In today’s volatile, uncertain, chaotic, and ambiguous (VUCA) world, continuous learning is essential for organizational success. Businesses need HR and L&D professionals who can develop employee learning strategies that directly support business goals, and this learning and development training helps you become one.






Who is the AIHR Learning & Development Certificate Program for?


The AIHR Learning and Development Certificate Program is designed for HR professionals looking to upskill in L&D and strengthen their ability to design, deliver, and evaluate impactful employee learning strategies. It’s ideal for HRBPs, talent development specialists, training managers, and anyone responsible for building learning programs that drive business results.








What other topics does the online training cover besides L&D strategy, skill gaps, and learning analytics?


In addition to those core areas, AIHR Learning and Development Certificate Program covers learning approaches, effective learning design and training delivery, knowledge management, organizational learning maturity, and how L&D fits into a broader talent strategy.


You’ll also explore informal learning practices, methods for building a learning culture, and practical tools to support corporate learning and development. A full overview of modules and lessons is available in the 
syllabus
.








How long do I have to complete AIHR L&D Certificate Program, and is there a set schedule?


AIHR Learning & Development Certificate Program is 100% online and self-paced, so you can decide when and how much time to dedicate each day, week, or month.


You’ll have 12 months of access to the student portal, lessons, and materials. Most participants finish in 3–4 months, investing around 35 hours to earn their digital Learning and Development Certificate.








Is the capstone project graded?


Yes! Your digital Learning and Development Certificate is awarded only after passing the capstone project. If you don’t pass on your first try, you can re-submit as many times as needed. All instructions, templates, and resources to complete the project are included in the program.








Which certification is best for Learning and Development?


The best L&D certification depends on your career goals, current experience, and the skills you want to develop. For HR professionals who want to strengthen their expertise in employee development strategy, instructional design, and learning analytics, AIHR is the best learning and development certification.


The program is fully online, recognized for SHRM PDCs, HRCI-, and ATD-accredited, and trusted by professionals at organizations like Meta, Henkel, and P&G.








What qualifications do I need for Learning and Development?


While there are no universal formal requirements to work in Learning and Development, employers often look for HR or training experience, strong communication skills, and knowledge of learning design and strategy.


The AIHR Learning and Development Certificate Program helps you build these learning and development skills through a fully online, SHRM- and HRCI-accredited curriculum. Upon completion, you’ll receive a digital certificate you can share with employers to showcase your expertise.








What resources can help me get started in Learning and Development?

Do you offer a money-back guarantee for certificate programs?


Yes! We pride ourselves on high-quality programs. That’s why we feel comfortable offering a 30-day money-back guarantee to ensure that you are 100% satisfied. If for any reason it’s not your thing, you can send us an email at support@aihr.com to request a full refund.








Is this program eligible for recertification credits by SHRM, HRCI and others?


The Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) is a trusted recertification partner of the world’s leading HR Associations, together representing over 1,000,000 HR professionals globally and offers HR programs eligible for recertification credits.

Why should I enroll in this Organizational Development Certification Program?


AIHR’s Organizational Development Certificate Program empowers you to shape organizations that perform and adapt. In this online OD training, you'll learn to implement organizational development strategies, design organizational structures, and guide culture change using practical, data-informed methods.


The program is built for professionals who want to move from reactive HR work to strategic impact, gaining the organizational development skills to build healthier, more resilient organizations. Upon completion, you’ll earn a globally recognized digital certificate, eligible for SHRM PDCs and accredited by HRCI and HRPA, to showcase your expertise in organizational development and design.






Who is the AIHR Organizational Development Certificate Program for?


The AIHR Organizational Development Certificate Program is ideal for HR professionals who want to take a more strategic role in how their organization evolves. It’s designed for those looking to build practical organizational development and design skills that improve performance, strengthen culture, and lead change.


Whether you’re an HR business partner, HR generalist, or a starting OD specialist, this program helps you expand your expertise and make a measurable impact on organizational effectiveness and growth.








How long do I have to complete AIHR Organizational Development Certificate Program, and is there a set schedule?


This certificate program is completely self-paced, giving you full flexibility to learn whenever it fits your schedule. You’ll have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. Most learners complete the program in 3 to 4 months, investing around 35 hours in total to finish the courses and earn their digital OD certificate.








Is the capstone project graded?


Yes. The capstone project is graded and serves as the final step to complete your Organizational Development Certificate Program. You’ll apply what you’ve learned by working through a case study, demonstrating your ability to use OD models, design org structures, and outline culture elements.


If your first submission doesn’t pass, you can resubmit as many times as needed. The program includes all the instructions, templates, and resources to help you successfully complete the project and get your digital OD certificate.








What is the best organizational development certification?


The best organizational development certification depends on your career goals, experience level, and the skills you want to build. For HR professionals who want to strengthen their expertise in organizational design, culture transformation, and change management, the AIHR Organizational Development Certificate Program offers one of the most practical and comprehensive training options available.


The program is fully online, eligible for SHRM PDCs, and accredited by HRCI and HRPA. Professionals from companies such as Unilever, Meta, and Ikea have used the program to build the organizational development and design skills needed to help their organizations adapt, grow, and perform better through change.








How do I become an OD practitioner?


Becoming an organizational development (OD) practitioner starts with understanding how organizations function and how people, processes, and structures interact. Most OD practitioners begin their careers in HR, learning and development, or management, then deepen their expertise through specialized organizational development training. Building a strong foundation in areas like change management, organizational design, and cultural transformation is essential.


The AIHR Organizational Development Certificate Program helps you gain these skills through practical learning so you can confidently apply OD principles in your organization and grow into an effective OD practitioner.








What resources can help me get started in organizational development?


Get started in organizational development with these recommended resources:




What Is Organizational Development? A Complete Guide


20 Organizational Development Examples From Top Businesses


Organizational Design: A Complete Guide


12 Types of Organizational Culture You Should Know


Leading a Successful Cultural Transformation at Your Organization

Why should I enroll in this HR Generalist Certification Program?


As an HR generalist, you have a broad set of responsibilities, from setting up policy frameworks to navigating difficult conversations. This demands a solid and diverse skill set, as well as strong foundational knowledge of various areas of HR. All of these can seem overwhelming when you're new to the role of HR generalist — or when you’re the only HR professional in an organization. And that's where the HR Generalist certificate program comes in.

This online HR generalist certification was created to help you master this challenging and dynamic role. It is 100% online and self-paced, so that you can learn whenever and wherever that works for you. The bite-sized lessons, quizzes, and downloadable materials help you understand the theory and translate it into practical new skills and competencies. After completing the HR generalist certificate program, you won't just have a certificate to add to your profile — you will have a robust set of skills that will set you up for long-term success.






Will this online training help me get started in HR?


The HR Generalist certificate program covers many topics you need to be familiar with in order to become an HR professional: recruitment and onboarding, the payroll process, performance management, policy frameworks, soft skills, and more.


That makes this a good online HR course for beginners, and a good fit if you’re taking your first steps in Human Resources Management. Thanks to the module dedicated to HR in a scaling organization, this is a particularly good fit for people who have just joined a growing business as their first HR hire, or who are transitioning into an HR role.








Do you offer a money-back guarantee for certificate programs?


Yes! We pride ourselves on high-quality programs. That’s why we feel comfortable offering a 30-day money-back guarantee to ensure that you are 100% satisfied. If for any reason it’s not your thing, you can send us an email at support@aihr.com to request a full refund.

The Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) is a trusted recertification partner of the world’s leading HR Associations, together representing over 1,000,000 HR professionals globally and offers HR programs eligible for recertification credits.


With AIHR, your learning hours count twice — once toward building in-demand HR skills, and again toward maintaining your existing credentials.

Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available.

Approaches that worked a few years ago will leave your organization vulnerable to a variety of risks. Why should I enroll in this Compensation & Benefits Certification Program?


The right Comp & Ben strategy has always been essential in attracting and retaining the talent your organization needs to win in the market. As companies face major talent shortages and new challenges such as the rise of remote work, C&B is only becoming more important.


In light of this, ambitious and strategic HR professionals need to be able to understand and speak the language of Compensation and Benefits. Only then will they be able to truly understand the challenges and opportunities within this area of expertise, and the way that it can impact the HR organization and company as a whole.


This course is also a good fit for HR professionals working in Comp & Ben at smaller organizations who wish to learn more about the field, or individual contributors or managers who want to set up or professionalize their Compensation and Benefits department.






Why can't I enroll in this C&B course right now?


AIHR’s online Certificate Programs open periodically, usually once a month. You can wait for enrollment to open again, or get Full Academy Access, which is available year-round. Full Academy Access grants you access not only to the Comp & Ben courses, but our entire catalogue of online HR education. This includes Certificate Programs that will help you further improve your C&B expertise, such as People Analytics and HR Manager.








Do you offer a money-back guarantee for certificate programs?


Yes! We pride ourselves on high-quality programs. That’s why we feel comfortable offering a 30-day money-back guarantee to ensure that you are 100% satisfied. If for any reason it’s not your thing, you can send us an email at support@aihr.com to request a full refund.

Why should I enroll in this Strategic Talent Acquisition Certification Program?


Recruiting and retaining the right talent remains a challenge for many companies. With rapidly changing employee expectations and business needs, as well as a fluctuating labor market, a strategic approach to talent acquisition is essential. In this online Strategic Talent Acquisition Certificate Program, you will develop the skills that will help you develop and execute a talent acquisition strategy that makes your organization an employer of choice for top talent. You will also learn how to take an evidence-based approach to talent acquisition, and to ensure your operations optimally support your strategy using the Agile methodology.






Do you offer a money-back guarantee for certificate programs?


Yes! We pride ourselves on high-quality programs. That’s why we feel comfortable offering a 30-day money-back guarantee to ensure that you are 100% satisfied. If for any reason it’s not your thing, you can send us an email at support@aihr.com to request a full refund.








Is this program eligible for recertification credits by SHRM, HRCI and others?


The Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) is a trusted recertification partner of the world’s leading HR Associations, together representing over 1,000,000 HR professionals globally and offers HR programs eligible for recertification credits.


With AIHR, your learning hours count twice — once toward building in-demand HR skills, and again toward maintaining your existing credentials.


This program is eligible for:
28
 SHRM PDCs
28 HR (General)
 Business HRCI Credits
28
 HRPA PDCs
See the full list
 of HR associations offering credits for the 
Strategic Talent Acquisition Certificate Program
.


Plus, as a registered education provider on LinkedIn, AIHR makes it easy to showcase your new credentials directly on your profile, boosting your professional visibility.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Do I need any software tools to complete this program?


No special software tools are required to complete this program. All materials needed are provided in the training platform.

Talent Management & Succession Planning 


Certificate Program





				     	As organizations grapple with uncertainty and complexity, talent practices must adapt. Business leaders are looking to talent management to create and develop a talent pipeline that delivers on profitability, innovation, and competitive advantage. A strategic approach to talent management is crucial to ensure that organizations can access, nurture, and retain the talent they need. This online Talent Management Certificate Program gives you the knowledge and skills to systematically implement talent management strategies that sustain and enable the business into the future.

Design a unified talent experience


Attracting, engaging, and developing the right talent is essential for a successful talent management practice. Find out how you can foster an environment that delivers a positive talent experience throughout the entire employee lifecycle, starting with practical tools for creating an employer brand and EVP that support your talent supply strategies. Learn how to deal with the single biggest threat to business continuity: unidentified flight risk, and how to leverage career management and talent mobility to keep your critical talent engaged and on board for the long term.

Why should I enroll in this Talent Management & Succession Planning  Certification Program?


The talent shortage is projected to reach 85 million people by 2030 (KornFerry, The $8.5 Trillion Talent Shortage). Unsurprisingly, 78% of business executives rank talent management as a priority (Zipdo, Essential Talent Management Statistics for 2023).


Yet only 13% of HR leaders consider their talent management practices ‘excellent,’ while 70% of HR leaders rate their organization’s ability to address their talent needs as ‘mediocre,’ according to the same Zipdo article.


Business leaders are looking toward talent management to ensure that organizations can deliver on their strategic intent, show shareholder value, and remain competitive. And this is exactly what you will learn to do in this online Talent Management & Succession Planning certificate program.








Does this certificate program also cover talent acquisition?


Some of the topics covered in the Talent Management & Succession Planning Certificate Program are also relevant for talent acquisition, such as the Employee Value Proposition and employer branding. However, talent acquisition is not the focus of this program.


AIHR offers a Strategic Talent Acquisition Certificate Program that dives deeper into Talent Acquisition. This can be purchased separately, or you can get access to both programs and more with the Full Academy Access License.








Do you offer a money-back guarantee for certificate programs?


Yes! We pride ourselves on high-quality programs. That’s why we feel comfortable offering a 30-day money-back guarantee to ensure that you are 100% satisfied. If for any reason it’s not your thing, you can send us an email at support@aihr.com to request a full refund.








Is this program eligible for recertification credits by SHRM, HRCI and others?


The Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) is a trusted recertification partner of the world’s leading HR Associations, together representing over 1,000,000 HR professionals globally and offers HR programs eligible for recertification credits.


With AIHR, your learning hours count twice — once toward building in-demand HR skills, and again toward maintaining your existing credentials.

Why should I enroll in this People Data & Business Insights Certification Program?


Businesses today look to HR for informed people recommendations and strategic insights. As an HR professional, you don’t need to be a data scientist, but you do need to be able to understand and communicate insights from people data. Without the skills to interpret or analyze the right information, your metrics won’t tell a clear story. 


The People Data and Business Insights Certificate Program gives you the practical skills and tools to act as a credible, strategic, and evidence-driven partner to the business. Through hands-on lessons and exercises with HR metrics, HR dashboards, Excel, Power BI, and proven analytics frameworks, you’ll be able to analyze data, identify meaningful patterns, and translate your findings into powerful insights leaders trust. 






What is the difference between this program and the People Analytics Certificate Program? 


The 
People Data and Business Insights Certificate Program
 is designed for HR professionals who want to become confident, data-driven partners. It’s the right course for you if you’d like to focus on building 
data literacy
 to translate 
HR metrics
 into clear business insights, influence decisions, and showcase HR’s impact on performance to elevate your strategic credibility. 


On the other hand, if you’re an HR professional who wants to advance into a more technical, data analysis role, go for the People Analytics Certificate Program. This program dives deeper into the science of People Analytics and teaches you how to validate causes, perform statistical tests like T-tests and ANOVA, and conduct more rigorous analysis. You’ll get the analytical depth you need to advance into roles such as People Analytics Specialist, HR Insights Analyst, or People Data Analyst. 


You also have the option to complete both programs: 




Start with the People Data and Business Insights Certificate Program to build a strong data literacy foundation. 


Advance to the People Analytics Certificate Program to deepen your analytical capabilities. 




Together, these two programs give you a powerful, end-to-end analytical learning track. If this is what you’re interested in, then check out the Full Academy Access License, which gives you access to not only these two programs but also every other certificate program AIHR has to offer, along with a career center, our Soft Skills Hub, and the AIHR Copilot. 








Which is the best certification for HR analytics? 


The certification that is best for HR analytics depends on a number of things, from your current level of 
data literacy
 to the reason you want to get an HR analytics certificate. To help you choose, here are a few of the criteria you should consider when selecting a program:




Strengthen your 
HR data 
and analytics skills


Enhance your ability to make data-driven decisions and recommendations to the business


Builds your confidence with 
HR data
 and analytics


Aligns with your continuing professional development needs


Provides recognition through a credible certificate 


Fits your schedule and learning style




If your goal is to become a data-driven HR partner to your business, an online, globally recognized program such as 
AIHR’s 
People Data and Business Insights Certificate Program
 offers one of the most complete and practical pathways available today.








Do I need HR analytics experience to enroll in this program?


The short answer is no. This program doesn’t require you to have any HR analytics background. It’s built for HR professionals who want to become more confident working with 
HR metrics
, 
HR data
, and 
HR dashboards
. You’ll start with foundational data skills and gradually build your capability to interpret data, read dashboards, and translate numbers into meaningful business insights.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

Why should I enroll in this Gen AI Prompt Design for HR mini course?


Generative AI skills have shifted from a nice-to-have to a must-have, yet many HR professionals struggle to craft effective prompts. This means HR is missing out on the vast opportunities for better productivity and efficiency that Gen AI provides.


The Gen AI Prompt Design for HR mini course is designed for HR professionals at any level who want to:




Crush their to-do list by streamlining or automating operational tasks, freeing up time for strategic, impactful, and purposeful work


Get started using Gen AI in a safe and secure way, and learn to spot more opportunities to leverage AI for solving day-to-day challenges


Take a leading role in their organization’s AI adoption with an in-demand, future-ready skill set that prepares them for the future of work




You’ll get everything you need to know to unlock the power of successful generative AI prompting in under 3 hours. The bite-sized, engaging video modules are paired with off-the-shelf templates, resources, and practical exercises—ensuring that you can immediately apply what you’ve learned.


Best of all, the Gen AI Prompt Design for HR mini course HR and AI subject matter expert walk you through real world insights and actionable advice to illustrate the impact of the techniques.








Do I need any previous Gen AI experience to take this course?


This is a Beginner/Intermediate level course. You won’t need any prior Gen AI experience, but prior HR experience and knowledge will be a plus.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

Why should I enrol in this HR Data Analyst course?


HR practices and activities are increasingly driven by data — and for good reason. Using data allows you to make fact-based and objective decisions that are proven to benefit your people and your organization. More than that, improving your data literacy will help you become a well-rounded and future-proof HR professional. Our HR Data Analyst course is designed to help you expand your HR toolkit with data analytics skills through a combination of video lessons, quizzes, and case studies. By the end of the course, you’ll be able to make HR decisions backed by data that you have collected and analyzed.








Why should I choose HR Data Analyst instead of a general Excel course?


The HR Data Analyst course is tailored specifically to the needs of HR Professionals. The course focuses on Excel functions that you will need to help you with your people data challenges.


You will also get access to templates and guides that will you will be able to use right away.


Finally, this course is structured as a series of case studies: you get a data set and a relevant business question and data set for each module. That means that you will get hands-on experience with using Excel to analyze HR data.








What are the job perspectives?


This course qualifies you for a wide array of HR analytics related roles such as HR (Data) Analyst, HRIS Analyst, HR Analytics Consultant.


The data analysis skills that you will develop with this course offer a solid foundation to specialize further for roles such as HR Data Scientist or Strategic Workforce Planning Specialist.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.






Do I need any software tools to complete this program?


No special software tools are required to complete this program. All materials needed are provided in the training platform.

Why should I enroll in this online HR Operating Model course?


The efficiency of HR’s service delivery can directly impact the bottom-line success of the organization. This is especially true in our current business environment that is marked by disruptions — from a global pandemic to a growing talent shortage. To ensure your organization can continuously adapt and thrive, you need a strong Human Resources Operating Model to maximize the value of your HR services and support the business in achieving its goals.


Having excellent HR skills alone is not enough. This online training course is designed to help you increase your skills and knowledge in everything you need to create an efficient and effective HR Operating Model. This includes understanding the business context and organizational structure, integrating HR technology, and designing and implementing HR processes.








How will this course help me become an HR manager?


Knowing how to design, build, and implement an effective Operating Model is key to tackling one of the most crucial responsibilities of an HR manager — optimizing HR’s service delivery to ensure the HR function can continuously deliver excellence. However, this alone is not enough to make you into an HR manager. You’ll also need to master HR strategy, HR management, business management, and stakeholder management, among other topics. These are all covered in our HR Manager Certificate Program, where you’ll also have the opportunity to work on a Capstone project and become a certified strategic HR manager.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.

Why should I enroll in this AI Strategy for HR online training course?


AI is transforming HR, but many HR professionals struggle to develop an effective adoption strategy. AI Strategy for HR gives you the roadmap to confidently integrate AI into HR workflows and ensure you stay ahead of industry shifts. The course breaks down the complexities into structured framework, guide, checklist, and template, making it easier to tackle the common HR challenges with AI.


The AI Strategy for HR course is designed for HR professionals at any level who want to build a clear AI adoption roadmap and upskilling strategies while identifying critical opportunities while reducing risks.










Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.

Learning & Development Strategy


Online Course





				     	Learn to develop an L&D strategy that supports the business. This online Learning & Development strategy course helps you develop the knowledge and expertise needed to craft an effective L&D strategy. After completing this course, you will know how to build a culture of learning, develop future leaders, and ensure your employees have what it takes to help your organization thrive in today’s marketplace.

Develop a high-impact L&D strategy


Build a Learning and Development strategy that turns your organization’s long-term objectives into measurable results. In this online training course, you’ll learn to map organizational learning maturity, design formal learning programs, and strengthen informal learning practices. After completing the course, you’ll be able to position L&D as a high-value strategic function that drives employee development and retention.

Why should I choose this Learning & Development strategy course?


With skills gaps growing and the half-life of skills shrinking rapidly, effective upskilling and reskilling initiatives are crucial for organizational success. It’s up to HR (and the L&D function, in particular) to make sure that employees are equipped with the skills and expertise they need to thrive, now and in the future. This online course will help you expand your HR toolkit with the strategic L&D skills you need to ensure that your HR strategies align with the overall business strategy.








What is the difference between this online L&D strategy course and the Learning & Development Certificate Program (LDCP)?


This is the second course in the AIHR Learning & Development Certificate Program. In addition to L&D strategy, this certificate program also covers key topics such as skills gap analysis, L&D analytics, and coaching and mentoring. This program is designed to help you become an L&D Specialist able to address today’s most pressing people challenges, such as overcoming skills gaps, retaining your top talent, and enabling your organization’s digital transformation.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.

Why should I enroll in this Succession Planning course? 


Succession planning is critical to the survival of any organization. Without a comprehensive approach to succession planning in place, your organization risks facing leadership gaps that can disrupt business continuity and hinder success.


As an HR professional, you’re responsible not just for filling immediate vacancies, but also strategically developing a pipeline of talent ready to step into critical roles when the need arises. This Succession Planning course will help you develop the capabilities to create talent maps, segment and develop leadership talent pools, and build a robust succession pipeline. 








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.

Why should I enroll in this online HR in a Scaling Business course?  


A scaling organization has different and more dynamic needs than more stable and established businesses. This means that during scaling-up process, HR’s priorities and focuses can shift quickly and unexpectedly. In order to help your business  sustainable growth, you need the knowledge and skills to build an agile and flexible HR operating model. This online HR in a Scaling Business course is designed to help you do just that. By enrolling in this course, you will be well-equipped to anticipate what comes next for your organization and address challenges you will encounter during scaling.








Do I need prior HR knowledge and/or experience to enroll in this course? 


Prior HR knowledge and/or experience is not required to enroll in this course. The HR in a Scaling Business course is designed for those taking their first steps in Human Resources. This course is especially a good fit if you have just joined a growing organization as their first HR hire, or are transitioning into an HR role. 








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.






Do I need any software tools to complete this program?


No special software tools are required to complete this program. All materials needed are provided in the training platform.

Workplace Health and Wellbeing


Online Course





				     	Are your employees engaged and supported or showing signs of burnout? A healthy workforce is the foundation of a successful organization. In this Workplace Health and Wellbeing course, you will learn how to develop and implement strategies to help your employees stay in top shape. Start cultivating a safe and healthy workplace by spearheading a company-wide approach to improve employee wellbeing and performance.

Why should I enroll in this Workplace Health and Wellbeing Course? 


Stress and burnout are detrimental to your employees’ physical and mental health and pose a significant threat to the success of your organization. Think decreased productivity, increased absenteeism, and high turnover rates. As an HR professional, you are in a unique position to advocate for employee wellbeing and work together with the organization to develop strategies that prioritize employee health and align with business goals.


This Workplace Health and Wellbeing Course is designed to equip you with the knowledge and tools you need to build a safe and thriving work environment where your employees can become their best selves. By the end of this course, you will be able to understand not only the ‘what’ and ‘why’ but also the ‘how’ of creating a workplace that prioritizes its employees’ physical and mental health.








What if I’d like to get this course for my team?


This course is automatically part of our 
Team License
. With this license, you will be able to help your team gain confidence in understanding employee wellbeing, how it impacts performance, and how to implement strategies to support a safe, more productive work environment. You will also have full access to our catalog of 11+ certificate programs (with new course added every month), a library of ready-to-use resources and templates to help your team increase their productivity and efficiency, and much more! Head over to our 
Team License
 page for a full overview of benefits that can help enhance your team’s performance! 








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This training is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.






How long do I have access to the course?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the member portal, all lessons and learning materials.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are available in English and come with English subtitles.






Is this online course the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this course is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which training best fits your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.






Why is this course not sold individually?


To optimize the quality of your learning experience, this course is not available for standalone enrollment and is either available as part of a Certificate Program or included with the Full Academy Access License.

Why should I enroll in this HR KPIs and OKRs mini course?


Many HR teams focus on tracking activity rather than impact, leaving goals disconnected from business priorities. This course changes that by guiding you through a practical approach to designing KPIs and OKRs that make HR a true driver of business success. You’ll be able to:




Prove HR’s value with confidence
: Link your people initiatives directly to measurable business outcomes, strengthening HR’s credibility at the leadership table.


Focus on what really matters
: Cut through vanity metrics and track only the goals that create impact.


Drive alignment within HR
: Build transparency and shared goals within HR first, then leverage that success to empower and guide other teams.




This course goes beyond theory by giving you ready-to-use checklists, templates, and interactive exercises you can apply right away. You’ll move from simply tracking HR activity to delivering real business impact, positioning HR as a true strategic partner in your company’s growth.








Who is this course for?




This course is perfect for HR professionals who know their work drives results, but need to quickly develop skills to communicate outcomes with clarity and effectiveness. The HR KPIs and OKRs mini course is especially useful if you’re leading change during a strategic shift and need alignment and transparency. It’s also beneficial for those looking to improve reporting and credibility and need a framework for implementing the right OKRs and KPIs.




You’ll leave with a simple, repeatable goal-setting system that equips HR—and every team you partner with—to deliver alignment, accountability, and impact that matters.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

Why should I enroll in this AI Strategy for HR Leaders online mini course?


Many HR leaders feel the weight of leading AI transformation without a clear plan. It’s easy to feel overwhelmed about where to begin, how to align AI with real business priorities, or how to get buy-in from key stakeholders. Without a solid strategy, AI can feel more like a risk than an opportunity.


This course is designed to change that by breaking down the complexities into an actionable framework. In just 3 hours, you’ll learn how to pinpoint AI opportunities, assess feasibility, manage risks, and create a compelling roadmap for adoption. With practical guides, checklists, and ready-to-use templates, you’ll walk away ready to apply what you’ve learned immediately, so you can lead your teams through AI-driven change with confidence, clarity, and measurable results.










Who is this course for?


This course is designed for forward-thinking HR leaders who want to take a strategic, business-driven approach to AI adoption. It’s a perfect fit if you:




Want to avoid costly missteps in AI adoption.
 If your organization is experimenting with AI but lacks a clear purpose, this course gives you a proven framework to build an AI strategy that delivers real business value, not just hype.


Are ready to move beyond scattered pilots.
 Instead of juggling scattered, ad-hoc AI experiments, you’ll learn how to build a coherent, business-aligned AI roadmap that connects your initiatives and drives tangible results.


Must secure buy-in and manage risks.
 You’ll discover how to gain stakeholder support and implement AI responsibly and ethically, so your initiatives succeed while minimizing unintended consequences.










Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

HR Consulting Skills


Mini Course





				     	Many HR professionals struggle to demonstrate impact and deliver value. Establish yourself as an effective partner to the business with this HR Consulting Skills mini course. Learn to use a simple, repeatable consulting approach to identify business problems, apply data-backed insights, and craft fit-for-purpose solutions that drive results. In just a few hours, you’ll have the skills to confidently influence stakeholders and elevate your role as a trusted advisor.					




Mini courses are short, focused courses designed to help you quickly gain new skills. They are included with the Full Access License and HR Essentials Membership.

 HR professionals


























Learning Objectives













                                                    Gather and synthesize business information, including understanding stakeholder roles				                                













                                                    Identify symptoms of business problems and uncover the root cause				                                













                                                    Make evidence-based recommendations and create stakeholder buy-in				                                













                                                    Measure, evaluate, and communicate unlocked value through key metrics

Become the trusted HR consultant


HR professionals require consulting skills to actively understand and help solve business problems. Learn new skills and uncover best practices to embrace a consulting mindset. This HR Consulting Skills mini course gives you a consulting framework with predefined steps and guidelines to identify obstacles, generate business-aligned HR solutions, track metrics, and communicate impact.

Why should I enroll in this HR Consulting Skills mini course?


The business traditionally sees HR as an administrative function rather than a strategic partner. HR’s inability to fully engage and guide business partners in solving challenges is rooted in a lack of consulting skills. HR professionals struggle to earn the trust they need, while lacking the confidence to engage stakeholders in meaningful conversations.


The HR Consulting Skills mini course is designed for HR business partners, internal HR consultants, independent external consultants, or any HR professional who wants to solve business problems effectively and drive maximum value through fit-for-purpose HR solutions. Because it’s a mini course, you gain essential consulting skills after just a few hours.


You will master a structured, repeatable consulting approach that enables you to identify business problems, develop aligned HR solutions, effectively engage with your stakeholders, and evaluate and communicate unlocked value. In addition, the HR Consulting Skills mini course makes it easy for you to apply what you’ve learned with templates and resources. Whether you’re new to your HR role or just need a quick refresher, the HR Consulting Skills mini course gives you the skills and tools to confidently consult the business and drive impact.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

Why should I enroll in this performance management course for HR?


Enroll in this performance management course if you want to get productivity and performance back on track in your organization with the right involvement from HR. In 
just 4 hours
, this mini course gives you practical tools and clear frameworks to redesign your performance management process.


You will explore different approaches to 
managing employee performance
 and confidently champion the best fit for your organization’s needs. You will understand how to activate and engage your stakeholders to focus on your role as architect and guardian of the process. And finally, you will learn how to navigate difficult conversations, such as those surrounding 
underperforming employees
, ensuring everyone gets the necessary input to take their performance to the next level.


If you don’t get those needed skills, your organizations risk pouring time and energy into wrong-fit performance processes that deliver more problems than productivity. Cycles that don’t align with the velocity of the business, feedback from the wrong stakeholders, focus on the wrong KPIs: there are a lot of ways that the conventional performance management process can miss the mark.








What training is needed for performance management?


HR professionals need structured training to design a strong 
performance management process
, enable managers, and address challenges. Without the right foundation, this process can become inconsistent and subjective, leaving managers unprepared and employees disengaged. 


AIHR’s Performance Management course for HR offers practical frameworks and techniques to build a high-impact performance management approach and enable managers to drive better results.


Want to start learning essential 
performance management skills
 today? Get 
Full Academy Access
 to unlock this course plus much more!








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.










Do I need any software tools to complete this program?


No special software tools are required to complete this program. All materials needed are provided in the training platform.

Why should I enroll in this Foundations for People Leadership mini course?


Starting your first management role is a big change — it’s no longer about doing the work yourself, but helping others succeed. You need to avoid the trap of trying to do it all, because micromanaging kills trust, weak delegation slows progress, and poor communication drags down performance.


This course gives you the guidance to become the manager who empowers, delegates wisely, and communicates with clarity, all within 4 hours. It is ideal for:




First-time managers seeking a structured path to transition from individual contributor to leader


HR and L&D professionals aiming to upskill new managers across the organization


Fast-growing companies that need to develop a strong pipeline of capable people leaders


Team leads or supervisors who manage people, even without an official “manager” title


Executives & senior managers who want to empower their management teams with strong leadership skills




The bite-sized, engaging video modules are paired with off-the-shelf playbooks, tools, and practical exercises — ensuring that you can immediately apply what you’ve learned.








How is this course different from AIHR’s HR Manager Certificate Program or the HR Business Partner program?




The Foundations for People Leadership mini course focuses on hands-on people management skills, such as delegation and relationship building. If your goal is to deepen your expertise in HR management, we recommend the 
HR Manager Certificate Program
. For those looking to drive a strategic impact and align HR with business goals, the 
HR Business Partner Certificate Program
 is a better fit.




This mini course is also a time-efficient option. It comes in a shorter format than a full Certificate Program, so you can learn quickly and save time for what matters the most.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.

Why should I enroll in this HR Trends & Strategies for 2026 mini course?


AI has already reshaped how organizations make decisions, design work, and deliver value. At the same time, uncertainty is rising, skills gaps are growing, and the pressure for speed and adaptability is increasing. These changes demand HR professionals quickly prioritize tactics and strategies to steer their organizations into a new world of work.


In this online course about HR trends and strategies for 2026, you get access to bite-sized videos analyzing the biggest developments affecting HR leaders, teams and professionals in the year to come. These videos are supported by recommended reading for quick access to more details, saving time searching for authoritative and trustworthy sources. Case studies and interactive exercises give you the opportunity to analyze the impact of trends and practically apply your learnings to your own organization and HR strategy.


In short, this course enables you to create a future-proof and effective HR strategy for 2026 in a fraction of the usual time.








Is there a fixed schedule?


No. This program is 100% online and self-paced! When you learn and how much time you spend each day, week, or month is up to you.

In total, you will need to invest approximately 35 hours to finish the program and obtain your certificate.






How long do I have access to the program?


In total, you will have 12 months of access to the student portal, all lessons, and learning materials. On average, members complete their (first) program in 3 - 4 months.






Which languages are the courses conducted in?


All courses are conducted in English with English subtitles available. 






Is this program the right fit for me?


If you’re not sure if this program is the right fit, we are here to help you determine which program is the right fit for your goals and needs! Simply talk to one of our admissions advisors or send them an email at support@aihr.com.










Do I need any software tools to complete this program?


No special software tools are required to complete this program. All materials needed are provided in the training platform.

Is it worth getting an HR certificate?






The short answer is yes. The long answer is yes, definitely!

An HR certificate demonstrates that you have the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in the field of HR. An HR certificate can give you an advantage over your uncertified peers by proving your dedication to and skill in the field of human resources.










What are the best HR courses for beginners?






If you’re new to the field, the best online HR course depends on your career preference. An online 
HR generalist course
 is a great starting point if you’re new to the profession. If you already know that you want to focus on recruitment or talent acquisition, a more specialized online training course might be a better choice.










What are the best advanced HR courses?






Advanced HR training courses let you deepen your expertise in a specific domain of HR. AIHR offers a wide range of HR online courses covering advanced topics such as compensation & benefits strategy, HR analytics, and candidate experience. No matter where you want to take your HR career, AIHR can help you make it a reality.










How do I know which HR course is best for me?






The 
HR Career Map
 shows you which online HR course will help you make your next move. It’s like an on-demand, digital career coach that makes choosing courses easy through interactive visuals. Use the career map to plot your career advancement, get insight into salary ranges, and see which HR training courses give you the skills, knowledge, and experience to meet your goals.










Why should I choose AIHR online HR courses?






No two HR careers are the same. We meet you where you’re at and support your journey. Our extensive library of online HR courses is designed to build skills anlets you learn what you need, whenever you want.


AIHR courses are practical, on-demand, self-paced, and 100% online so that you can learn on your own terms. This makes it easy to build new skills, refresh existing expertise, and stay up to date with HR trends and developments.










Can I enroll in just one course?






AIHR courses are not available individually. Instead, you can enroll in a Certificate Program or get a Full Academy License.


Enrolling in a Certificate Program grants access to your program of choice, regular live events, the lively AIHR Community, as well as several mini courses on topics like ChatGPT and wellbeing. You also get access to our full suite of career tools, including assessments, an extensive Resource Library, the HR Career Map, and more.


If you want access to everything you need to accelerate your HR career, you can also get the Full Academy License. This gives you access to AIHR’s full catalog of HR content, tools, and templates.


















Online HR training at AIHR


AIHR supports innovation in Human Resources by empowering HR practitioners like you. By combining effective online courses with practical resources and career planning tools, we are the all-in-one platform for ambitious HR professionals who want to make a difference.


You can use AIHR’s constantly expanding library of certificate programs, templates, mini courses, and guides to deepen your expertise in your current specialization, branch out into other HR domains, or get off to a flying start as a new starter in HR. Enrolling at AIHR means getting access to exclusive, on-demand learning content on everything from entry level general HR to advanced Compensation & Benefits analytics and beyond, as well as the latest developments and trends like ChatGPT for HR.


In short, AIHR is more than online HR courses. It’s everything you need to hit your HR career goals, at your own pace, and on your own path.


What are the benefits of online HR courses?


Online HR courses let you expand and refresh your skills on your own terms. On-demand, self-paced, and bite-sized: online HR courses let you learn whenever and wherever works best for you.


If you’ve struggled with online training courses in the past, it could be that you thrive in a more social approach to learning, or have a hard time staying engaged with long, passive videos. AIHR solves this with our learning methodology designed for engagement and practicality. This, combined with our active online HR community, means that you get the benefits of online courses and classical training in a single package.


With AIHR, it’s easier than ever to build the skills and expertise you need to succeed in HR.

Effective business partnering skills


Effective HR business partnering blends strategic thinking, business acumen, and strong interpersonal skills. It involves translating business goals into actionable people strategies, asking the right questions to uncover root causes, and building trust with leaders. It also requires people analytics skills, such as analyzing eNPS, employee retention rates, and quality of hire, to inform decisions.


As HR becomes more strategic and consultative, these capabilities are increasingly expected of all HR professionals, not just those with the HRBP title. Developing effective business partnering skills helps you stay relevant, increase your impact, and future-proof your HR career as expectations of the role continue to evolve.


HR business partnering courses at AIHR


Become a strategic advisor to the business with HR business partnering courses at AIHR. Whether your goal is to gain a seat at the table, advance your career as an HRBP, or close a specific skills gap, you’ll find the right learning path to reach your career goals.


Our certificate programs are designed to provide in-depth expertise in a specific domain. The 
HR Business Partner 2.0 Certificate Program
 helps you become an effective all-around HRBP. For more senior professionals, the 
HR Consulting Certificate Program
 offers advanced frameworks to operate as high-level consultants to the business. Upon completing a certificate program, you’ll receive a certificate to validate your expertise. 


If you prefer shorter, practical courses to sharpen a specific capability, options such as 
AI Tutorials for HRBPs
, the 
HR KPIs and OKRs mini course
, and other under–3–hour programs help you quickly build hands-on skills needed to excel as a strategic partner.


All of these options are available in the

What is HR business partnering?






HR business partnering is a capability that enables HR professionals to work closely with leaders and managers, understand their priorities, and deliver people solutions that drive business performance. It combines business acumen, consulting skills, HR expertise, and strong stakeholder relationships. While often associated with the HR Business Partner role, these skills are increasingly expected across all areas of HR.










What are the top HR business partnering skills?






Top HR business partnering skills include:




Business acumen
: Understanding how the organization operates, gains revenue, and measures success.


Consulting and problem-solving
: Asking the right questions, diagnosing challenges, and co-creating solutions.


Stakeholder management
: Building trust, managing expectations, and guiding leaders effectively.


Data-driven decision-making
: Using people analytics to support recommendations and measure impact.


Strategic thinking
: Connecting HR initiatives to business goals and organizational strategy.


AI fluency
: Understand the holistic AI landscape to advise the business and become more productive, saving time for strategic work.




AIHR offers comprehensive HR business partnering courses like
 HR Business Partner 2.0 Certificate Program
 and 
HR Consulting Certificate Program
, as well as shorter courses available through 
Full Academy Access
 membership, that cover all these key capabilities.










How do you develop HR business partnering skills?






You can develop HR business partnering skills by combining structured learning with hands-on experience. Some HR business partnering skills can be developed on the job, such as communication and business acumen. But if you lack exposure in your current role to achieve these skills or want to approach your learning in a structured, guided way, online HR business partnering courses help you bridge this gap.


To support this development, AIHR offers a range of HR business partnering learning options. You can build deep, end-to-end capability through the 
HR Business Partner 2.0 Certificate Program
 or the 
HR Consulting Certificate Program
, both designed to develop strategic thinking, consulting skills, and real-world impact. Alongside these programs, 
Full Academy Access
 gives you access to shorter, targeted HR business partnering courses that let you strengthen specific skills as your role evolves, ensuring you can grow at every stage of your HRBP journey.










Why choose AIHR for HR business partnering courses?






Business partnering is a hands-on capability, and AIHR is built for hands-on learning. AIHR’s programs focus on real-world applications with the 
Tell-Show-Do-Apply method
. For example, you’ll practice consulting conversations, apply frameworks to real business cases, and use ready-made tools and templates you can immediately bring into stakeholder meetings. You’ll also have access to an active HR community where you can share ideas and insights.


AIHR programs are eligible for 
recertification credits
 
with SHRM, HRCI, HRPA, and other organizations, allowing you to advance your credentials while building capabilities that make a measurable impact.

Is it worth getting an HR certificate?






The short answer is yes. The long answer is yes, definitely!

An HR certificate demonstrates that you have the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in the field of HR. An HR certificate can give you an advantage over your uncertified peers by proving your dedication to and skill in the field of human resources.










What are the best HR courses for beginners?






If you’re new to the field, the best online HR course depends on your career preference. An online 
HR generalist course
 is a great starting point if you’re new to the profession. If you already know that you want to focus on recruitment or talent acquisition, a more specialized online training course might be a better choice.










What are the best advanced HR courses?






Advanced HR training courses let you deepen your expertise in a specific domain of HR. AIHR offers a wide range of HR online courses covering advanced topics such as compensation & benefits strategy, HR analytics, and candidate experience. No matter where you want to take your HR career, AIHR can help you make it a reality.










How do I know which HR course is best for me?






The 
HR Career Map
 shows you which online HR course will help you make your next move. It’s like an on-demand, digital career coach that makes choosing courses easy through interactive visuals. Use the career map to plot your career advancement, get insight into salary ranges, and see which HR training courses give you the skills, knowledge, and experience to meet your goals.










Why should I choose AIHR online HR courses?






No two HR careers are the same. We meet you where you’re at and support your journey. Our extensive library of online HR courses is designed to build skills anlets you learn what you need, whenever you want.


AIHR courses are practical, on-demand, self-paced, and 100% online so that you can learn on your own terms. This makes it easy to build new skills, refresh existing expertise, and stay up to date with HR trends and developments.










Can I enroll in just one course?






AIHR courses are not available individually. Instead, you can enroll in a Certificate Program or get a Full Academy License.


Enrolling in a Certificate Program grants access to your program of choice, regular live events, the lively AIHR Community, as well as several mini courses on topics like ChatGPT and wellbeing. You also get access to our full suite of career tools, including assessments, an extensive Resource Library, the HR Career Map, and more.


If you want access to everything you need to accelerate your HR career, you can also get the Full Academy License. This gives you access to AIHR’s full catalog of HR content, tools, and templates.


















Online HR training at AIHR


AIHR supports innovation in Human Resources by empowering HR practitioners like you. By combining effective online courses with practical resources and career planning tools, we are the all-in-one platform for ambitious HR professionals who want to make a difference.


You can use AIHR’s constantly expanding library of certificate programs, templates, mini courses, and guides to deepen your expertise in your current specialization, branch out into other HR domains, or get off to a flying start as a new starter in HR. Enrolling at AIHR means getting access to exclusive, on-demand learning content on everything from entry level general HR to advanced Compensation & Benefits analytics and beyond, as well as the latest developments and trends like ChatGPT for HR.


In short, AIHR is more than online HR courses. It’s everything you need to hit your HR career goals, at your own pace, and on your own path.


What are the benefits of online HR courses?


Online HR courses let you expand and refresh your skills on your own terms. On-demand, self-paced, and bite-sized: online HR courses let you learn whenever and wherever works best for you.


If you’ve struggled with online training courses in the past, it could be that you thrive in a more social approach to learning, or have a hard time staying engaged with long, passive videos. AIHR solves this with our learning methodology designed for engagement and practicality. This, combined with our active online HR community, means that you get the benefits of online courses and classical training in a single package.


With AIHR, it’s easier than ever to build the skills and expertise you need to succeed in HR.
