The Organizational Development Boot Camp




Program structure
Blend self-paced courses with teamwork, projects, live sessions, and a demo day.
Results & Outcomes
91% of HR Managers see team results within 6 months of the Boot Camp.
Key Projects & Resources
Get your team ready for real-world challenges instantly after the Boot Camp.


The Organization Development Boot Camp trains your HR team(s) to adapt to change and become a leading force for HR transformation throughout the company.


What your team will learn:


 
1. Organization Development Theories & Principles
 
Learn about the 5 phases of OD to ensure your organization is effective and efficient. Recognize triggers, select the right model, and gather data for effective organizational analysis.


 
2. Consult effectively to create impact
 
Understand how current and future business challenges link to people-related challenges and learn to use scientific knowledge and data to provide evidence-based support for decision making.


 
3. Build a strong and healthy company culture
 
Create a culture that is aligned with your business’s vision, mission, and core values. We teach your team to identify different types of cultures and the factors you need to consider when designing a culture.


 
4. Master your HR Operating Model
 
Know inside-out the step-by-step process of designing a Human Resources Operating Model optimized for your organization. Establish core HR processes — including recruitment, benefits administration, and performance management.


 
5. Completing the Capstone Project
 
Engage your HR team in an interactive project that simulates real-world HR challenges. They’ll perform descriptive analyses, build reports in Power BI, and test hypotheses, ensuring they can apply their learned skills in real business scenarios.


Request Demo
Investing in the Organizational Development Boot Camp will transform your HR department into a strategic powerhouse. Here’s how this training will empower your team and deliver substantial business value:


 
Expertise to Future-Proof your organization
 
Get your team to understand the design process — including how to approach OD delivery. Monitor external factors that trigger the OD process using four popular models and overcome any challenges arising during the course of your organizational design project.


 
Create & Sustain your company culture
 
Equipped with the know-how to implement and address intercultural initiatives, your Team will better align with the business to achieve its strategic objectives. They’ll learn to identify potential hurdles and align leaders with your current and aspired culture.


 
Gather Data & build OD Models
 
The boot camp will also focus on the art of storytelling with data. Your team will learn how to integrate data visualizations into their presentations effectively, allowing them to communicate insights and influence stakeholders with compelling, data-driven narratives.


 
Effectively communicate with key stakeholders
 
Understand how current and future business challenges link to people-related challenges. You will also develop the ability to connect and communicate effectively with key stakeholders and learn consulting techniques used to implement organization development interventions.


 
Real-World Application
 
Through a capstone project, your team will apply their newfound skills to simulate and solve real-world HR problems. This hands-on experience ensures they are ready to implement data-driven solutions immediately.

What makes our Boot Camps different?
 








Focus on applying knowledge
 


Boot Camps add an extra layer of practice on top of the 
tell-show-do-apply
 learning approach of the learning modules by having learners work in groups on a pre-defined project.










Learn with your team

High engagement
 


Clear milestones, group work, and live learning sessions provide accountability to keep up with the program and finish self-study modules on time.










Clear impact & ROI
 


The targeted nature of Boot Camps and pre-defined time frames increase completion rates and drive visible impact in terms of behavior change in the moments that matter.

SUPPORT


FAQs

How do I enroll my team in a boot camp?






Given the tailored nature of a boot camp, we advise you to get in touch with one of our learning specialists to select the program that best fits your needs and learning objectives. You can 
grab a slot on their calendar
 or get in touch with Oisin via 
oisin.oreilly@aihr.com
.


Please note that the boot camp is available as a program-management add-on to one of our team plans, and cannot be purchased separately. You can explore our team plans here.










Are there any prerequisites for the Organizational Development boot camp?






HR Boot Camps are designed to be inclusive to any HR Professional and do not have any prerequisites. We recommend a minimum of 1 year work experience in a relevant HR role, but they are made to still be as relevant & valuable for an HR professional with 25+ years of experience.










Is there a fixed schedule?






The Boot Camp is designed to help your team level up in the shortest possible time frame, given their learning goal and availability. During the onboarding session with your learning consultant, you will agree on a timeline and set fixed dates for the program kick-off, live sessions and graduation day. Before each live session, learners are expected to have completed a certain percentage of the online self-paced learning.










Is this program the right fit for my team?






An HR Boot Camp is the fastest and most effective way of closing a specific skills gap, or establishing a baseline of knowledge in your team.


The cohort-based learning on a predetermined schedule ensures that your team stays on track and engaged with the learning content. Our clients have seen increased completion rates, practical application of the learning content, and enhanced collaboration between cohort members. In addition, outsourcing the program management to our expert learning consultants has been a game-changer for busy HR leaders who want to maximize results and minimize their time investment.


In case you need help determining which boot camp is the right fit to reach your team and company goals, book a call with one of our learning specialists. 
Grab a slot on their calendar
 or get in touch with Oisin via 
oisin.oreilly@aihr.com
.










How can I be sure that this boot camp will work?






In contrast to many other learning solutions, our boot camps prioritize practicality above all. We don’t just teach; we immerse your team in real-world scenarios. We use relevant examples, collaborate with amazing experts, and our curriculum is enriched with numerous exercises, case studies, and practical templates for when your team will actually apply it.


Our tell-show-do-apply learning methodology ensures that you not only gain knowledge through video lessons (tell + show) but also get ample opportunities to practice and apply what you’ve learned (do + apply). With a multitude of examples, we ensure that your team is well-equipped to tackle real-world challenges post-boot camp.


The end result is a practical project that will be implemented in your organization.










What makes AIHR different from others?






The combination of a structured, hands-on learning journey with features like the resource library, packed with practical templates and tools, live events, community, and bite-sized learnings, means that AIHR is not just an online academy, but a full HR Upskilling Platform that provides your people with the resources to bring learnings into their job, get expert support, and stay up-to-date on the latest HR skills and trends.










How much time/effort will this take from me & the team?






Completing an HR Boot Camp usually takes about 40 hours per learner distributed over a 3 to 6 month period. 


As project lead, you can expect to spend around 10-15 hours aligning with your Learning Consultant and driving the initiative internally.

Safe. Responsible. Confident.

AI Fluency Scan
Assessment
The AI Fluency Scan helps participants understand their current capabilities in using, integrating, and interacting with AI. It assesses five key dimensions: 
AI Application
, 
AI Interaction
, 
AI Work Integration
, 
Responsible AI Use
, and 
AI Adoption Advocacy
.


Each participant receives a personalized report highlighting their strengths, development areas, and practical recommendations to improve their AI fluency. The results provide a clear baseline for the team, supporting focused discussions and tailored learning throughout the boot camp.


Advanced Prompting Workshop
Live Facilitated Session
Advanced Prompting Workshop:


 In this session, participants dive deep into how large language models (LLMs) think, reason, and fail—and how to leverage that understanding for more effective AI use. The workshop explores core LLM limitations such as 
hallucinations
, 
jagged intelligence
, 
memory loss
, 
sycophancy
, and 
shallow reasoning
, and provides concrete techniques to mitigate them through better prompt engineering.


Participants learn and practice advanced prompting methods, including 
prompt folding
, 
meta prompting
, 
step-by-step and chain prompting
, and 
escape hatching
. They also experiment with concepts like 
agentic AI
 and 
custom GPTs
 to expand what’s possible in real-world HR applications.


By the end, participants will not only understand 
how
 to design advanced prompts but also 
why
 certain prompts work—equipping them to reason through model behavior, improve reliability, and confidently apply LLMs to complex, high-stakes HR tasks such as policy creation, workforce analytics, and talent strategy.


AI for HR 101
Self-paced learning
This foundational module introduces participants to the fundamentals of AI and how it transforms HR, equipping them with the knowledge and tools to apply it responsibly and effectively.




Understanding AI:
 Learn what AI is, how it applies to HR, and how to manage its risks responsibly.


Enhancing HR Practices with Gen AI:
 Discover how generative AI can boost efficiency through content creation, data insights, automation, and productivity.


AI in Practice:
 Explore real-world examples and frameworks showing how AI is applied across L&D, talent acquisition, and people analytics.




Prompt Design for HR
Self-paced learning
This module builds the foundation for effective AI interaction by teaching participants how to craft clear, targeted, and high-impact prompts tailored to HR tasks. By the end, participants will be able to translate HR challenges into well-structured prompts that consistently generate valuable, accurate, and actionable results.




Prompt Design Fundamentals:
 Learn the core principles of effective prompt writing using the BRIEF Framework, avoid common mistakes, and practice chaining and optimizing prompts for higher-quality AI output.


ChatGPT for HR:
 Apply prompting skills in hands-on HR scenarios (including writing job descriptions, designing workshops, analyzing data, and selecting HRIS vendors) while gaining access to practical resources and demos to enhance everyday HR work.




Application Workshop
Live Facilitated Session
In this interactive session, participants turn their AI knowledge into real-world impact by identifying and designing practical AI solutions for HR. Using the 
AI Use Case Canvas
, they explore common applications across areas such as talent acquisition, learning and development, and HR operations, and learn how to evaluate feasibility, data requirements, and ethical considerations.


Through this exercise, participants come up with AI-powered solutions for day-to-day HR challenges, by defining problems, setting success metrics, and mapping out where AI can create measurable value. By the end of the workshop, they walk away with a clear portfolio of actionable AI initiatives.


Using Gen AI in HR
Self-paced learning
This module helps participants apply advanced generative AI techniques to real HR tasks, focusing on precision, consistency, and measurable impact. Through structured exercises and hands-on activities, they learn to build reusable prompt templates, structure inputs with delimiters, and apply contrastive prompting to improve the accuracy and analytical depth of AI outputs. By the end, participants will know how to use generative AI not just to save time, but to enhance the quality, reliability, and insightfulness of their HR work.


Ethics, Privacy & Data Security
Self-paced learning
This module helps participants understand how to use AI responsibly and securely within HR workflows. It explores how to recognize AI’s limitations, protect sensitive employee data, and identify potential bias or fairness issues in AI-generated outputs.


Participants also learn to verify AI results before acting on them, follow company AI policies, and maintain clear documentation when AI is used in critical HR processes.


By the end of the module, participants will be able to:




Apply ethical and transparent AI practices in day-to-day HR activities


Safeguard employee data and ensure compliance with organizational policies


Evaluate and address potential bias or inaccuracy in AI-driven decisions




Agentic AI
Self-paced learning
This module introduces participants to the emerging concept of 
agentic AI
. Participants learn how these AI agents differ from traditional automation or conversational tools like ChatGPT, and why they represent a major shift in how HR work can be organized and scaled.


Through demos and strategic discussions, participants explore high-impact HR use cases such as onboarding follow-ups, compliance tracking, interview scheduling, and HR reporting. They then learn to 
map and structure workflows
 to identify where agentic AI can take over repetitive or process-driven tasks.


By the end, participants will understand the strategic potential of agentic AI, know how to recognize opportunities for its use, and be equipped to collaborate effectively with technical teams or vendors to implement these solutions responsibly and securely.


Demo Day (Capstone Project)
Live Facilitated Session
In the final stage of the boot camp, participants showcase what they’ve learned by presenting their 
AI use cases
 and proposed solutions to peers and facilitators. This session brings together all elements of the learning journey, demonstrating how these concepts translate into real organizational impact.


Through their 
Capstone Project
, participants articulate the business problem, AI opportunity, and expected outcomes of their use case, receiving feedback to refine and strengthen their ideas. By the end, they leave with a clear and actionable AI initiative tailored to their HR context, as well as the confidence to champion AI adoption within their organization.

FAQs
Have more questions? 
Get in touch
 with one of our sales consultants.

How do I enroll my team in a boot camp?






Given the tailored nature of a boot camp, we advise you to get in touch with one of our learning specialists to select the program that best fits your needs and learning objectives. You can 
grab a slot on their calendar
 or get in touch via 
sales@aihr.com
.










What is the duration of the boot camp?






The duration of the boot camp is flexible. We work with teams who fit the full program in
 just one month
, with weekly learning goals, but we also work with teams that like a more gradual approach and distribute the learning journey across a 
3 to 6 month period
.




The AI boot camp for 
HR teams
 consists of 6 hours of core (self-paced) learning content + 3 hours of (optional) live sessions + a 1-hour (optional) monthly expert Q&A.


The AI boot camp for 
HR leaders
 consists of 4 hours of core (self-paced) learning content + 3 hours of live sessions + a 1-hour (optional) monthly expert Q&A.




You can discuss your learning goals and timelines with one of our sales consultants during a 
free discovery meeting
.










Is there a fixed schedule?






During the onboarding session with your learning consultant, you will agree on a timeline and set fixed dates for the program kick-off, live sessions, and demo/graduation day. Before each live session, learners are expected to have completed a certain percentage of the online self-paced learning.










What is the difference between an open and a closed boot camp?








A closed boot camp is dedicated to your team, and access is restricted to the participants you sign up. This means that you, together with your assigned learning consultant, decide the pace and when sessions are scheduled.


An open boot camp (only available for the HR Leadership track) brings participants from different organizations together into one group. Open boot camps typically host between 5 and 10 participants.












Is there a live learning component?






Yes!


Both the boot camp for HR Teams and HR Leadership have up to 3 live sessions, facilitated by one of our AIHR faculty members.


In addition, there is a monthly expert Q&A webinar on AI, which is open to all AI boot camp participants for as long as your platform access is valid. This is a great place to get your questions answered and to be inspired by what people from other organizations are doing.










What type of support can we expect?






During the pre-sale orientation process you can count on one of our sales reps to inform your decision making and answer any questions you may have. You can contact them via email or hop on a quick call when needed.


After signing up you will meet your assigned learning consultant. They will be your contact person throughout the boot camp, coordinating the kick-off, schedule, live sessions, onboarding of your team, and any other things that come up during the process. It is their primary goal to make sure to, together with you, maximize the impact of the boot camp for you team.

Support


FAQs

 with one of our sales consultants.
 










What is the HR Audit?






The HR Audit is an independent, data-driven review of how an organization’s HR function performs today and how ready it is to meet future business challenges. AIHR’s team assesses HR strategy, structure, processes and materials, and delivers a clear diagnostic including maturity benchmarking, improvement areas and a practical roadmap.










What do you get as part of the HR Audit deliverables?






The deliverables include: (1) a functional diagnostic reviewing HR strategy, structure and materials; (2) stakeholder interviews & workshops to understand how HR is operating in practice; (3) benchmarking of your HR function against global best-in-class practices; (4) a practical report with prioritized recommendations, timelines and a roadmap to strengthen HR’s impact.










What is the 5SL Model and how is it linked to the HR Audit?






We approach an HR Audit through the lens of the 5SL model, a holistic, research-backed framework that assesses the health and effectiveness of an HR function across five core dimensions, with strong leadership and culture at the center.


Specifically, we evaluate:




Strategy: 
how well HR objectives align with the overall business priorities.


Structure: 
whether the HR operating model, roles and responsibilities allow for effective execution.


Skills: 
whether the HR team has the right expertise and capabilities to meet current and future demands (including digital/data skills).


Systems of Work: 
whether processes, technology, data, and governance enable efficient, scalable HR service delivery.


Stakeholders: 
how strong and credible HR’s relationships are with business leaders and other key stakeholders.




At the core of the model sits 
HR Leadership
 which binds these dimensions together, ensuring alignment, credibility, and a mindset that supports sustainable HR impact.


This ensures that the audit does not just look at isolated processes, but offers a comprehensive diagnostic of where HR stands — what works, what needs improvement, and how HR can evolve to become a truly strategic partner to the business.










Who are your experts?






Our team consists of seasoned HR professionals and subject matter experts with diverse backgrounds. They bring a wealth of experience and knowledge to each engagement. You’ll work directly with these experts to achieve your HR goals.










When should an organization consider doing an HR Audit?






An HR Audit is especially useful when HR’s contribution is unclear, HR priorities are misaligned with business needs, or during times of business disruption (e.g. organizational change, restructuring, scaling, or new strategic challenges). It helps identify gaps and opportunities, and provides clarity and alignment.










Do you need to commit to a full HR transformation project to start with an HR Audit?






No. The HR Audit is offered as a standalone service. You can engage only in the audit to get clarity on where HR stands now — and then decide separately whether to follow up with transformation or improvement initiatives.

3 Ways HRBPs Can Redefine HR’s Role in Business	
It's hard to drive impact when you're drowning in administrative tasks. AIHR's training develops the capabilities HRBPs need to bridge the gap between people and business strategy. It’s time for HR to lead, not just support.
 


Think Strategically
HRBPs need to prioritize critical projects & plan strategically to maximize business outcomes.
Build Better Relationships
Become a trusted and credible HR partner to the business, that can deliver on set goals.
Make it Measurable
HRBPs need to measure the impact of their initiatives & effectively communicate the results.


Becoming a Strategic HR Business Partner


HRBPs should do more than just participate in leadership discussions, they should shape them. To earn credibility and influence business decisions, HRBPs need the right skills to demonstrate HR’s value, drive strategy, and engage with business leaders at all levels.


Our training programs equip HRBPs to act as strategic advisors, helping organizations identify trends, address challenges, and deliver actionable solutions that impact the bottom line.


Related Capabilities:




Strategic Thinking
 – Align HR initiatives with long-term business goals to drive organizational success.


Problem-Solving
 – Identify root causes of operational challenges and develop effective solutions.


Business Acumen
 – Gain a deep understanding of business operations and profitability drivers.


Financial Literacy
 – Interpret budgets, forecasts, and P&L statements to make data-driven decision.




HRBPs: Trusted Advisors


A great HRBP is more than just a technical project manager. To truly earn a seat at the table, they must become knowledgeable communicators, trusted and credible advisors who can engage leadership with confidence.


Our training programs equip HRBPs to navigate executive conversations, advocate for HR initiatives, and drive business impact using tangible, verifiable analytics.


Related Capabilities:




Stakeholder Engagement
 – Communicate effectively with department heads and leadership.


Influencing and Negotiation
 – Ability to advocate for HR initiatives and secure leadership buy-in.


Executive Presence
 – Confidence to contribute in senior leadership meetings.


Consultative Approach
 – Advise leadership based on evidence and insights.




People Analytics That Tells a Story


Success in HR isn’t just about collecting data, it’s about transforming workforce insights into strategic action. The key lies in making analytics compelling, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.


Our training programs equip HRBPs to harness the power of people analytics, identifying the right data points, conducting meaningful analysis, and crafting narratives that resonate with leadership and drive change.


Related Capabilities:




Data Literacy
 – Teach teams to use HR data for better decision-making.


Data Analysis
 – Interpret workforce trends and use data to forecast needs.


Data Storytelling
 – Present workforce data in a compelling way to influence decision-making.


Critical Thinking
 – Evaluate data objectively and connect insights to business objectives.














We Provide Targeted Skills Building for HRBPs
Focus on data-driven storytelling, strategic planning and stakeholder management.
 






Build a Credible Presence


Ensuring HR has a seat at the table doesn’t mean just showing up. Make your HRBPs the strategic voice of your team, equipped to navigate leadership conversations with confidence.








Data Storytelling


Understanding people analytics is just the beginning. To truly drive change, HRBPs must master the art of storytelling, translating data into insights that matter to their stakeholders.








Business Through the HR Lens


People are at the core of the business, and HRBPs are pivotal in shaping their experience. We equip your HRBPs with the tools to translate business goals into impactful HR strategies driving growth.

What makes AIHR different from others?






AIHR isn’t just an online academy — it’s a complete HR upskilling platform built for real-world impact.


We combine structured, hands-on learning journeys with powerful tools like a practical resource library, live expert events, an engaged global community, and bite-sized content that fits into the flow of work.


This means your team doesn’t just learn—they apply new skills immediately, get support when it matters most, and stay ahead of the curve with the latest HR trends and practices.










What kind of support will my team get?






Your team license includes three levels of support:


A dedicated Learning Consultant (for teams of 10+)

To help you drive adoption and achieve measurable business impact. They’ll ensure you and your team are set up for success and aligned with your learning goals. Upon request, your Learning Consultant will schedule a kickoff session for you and your team.


Personal Learning Coaches for each team member

These coaches help individuals design their learning journeys, stay accountable, and make progress aligned with their career goals.


Access to the AIHR Community

Join over 50,000 HR professionals and subject matter experts to get input, feedback, and inspiration on real-world HR challenges.


Clients with six or more users receive dedicated learning support.










Does each user get access to all programs?






Yes! Every team member gets unlimited access to the full AIHR curriculum—including all courses, Certificate Programs, resources, coaching, and our global HR community.


They are also get access to all future course and Certificate Program releases.

 Provide tailored learning journeys focused on application and behavior change, directly linked to your HR capability model.

 Learning journeys designed with practical exercises and immediate applicability, closing the gap between theory and practice.

 Curated learning experiences that are engaging, tailored to individual needs, and available in multiple languages.




Foster Active Learning & On-the-Job Application

How can you help my company's HR Transformation?






Many of our clients come to us knowing they need to improve or transform their HR function, but aren’t exactly sure what’s needed. We offer discovery sessions to help you get a clear picture of where you are and what options you have before committing to anything bigger. Then we can recommend the right next steps — whether it’s strategy refinement, capability building, skills development or full-on transformation. Our goal is to ensure your HR Teams can reach their goals.










What is your approach?






Our approach is collaborative and data-driven, ensuring that we understand your specific needs. We utilize insights from our extensive community of professionals to inform our strategies. This ensures that our solutions are both innovative and practical.










Who are your experts?






Our team consists of seasoned HR professionals and subject matter experts with diverse backgrounds. They bring a wealth of experience and knowledge to each engagement. You’ll work directly with these experts to achieve your HR goals.










How can I start?






Starting with us is simple! You can reach out through our contact form or schedule a consultation. Our team will guide you through the process and discuss how we can best support your needs.










How does AIHR compare to other HR consultancies or training providers?






AIHR is your all-in-one platform for unlocking a strategic mindset and accelerating execution excellence. And because no two organizations are the same, we meet your team where they are and support their learning journey based on the goals you set.


Our advisors are seasoned HR professionals with both strategic and C-level experience in global organizations – they’ve seen it all and have proven know-how in building successful people strategies with business impact at their core.


Content-wise, our certificate programs and courses combine theory with practice to help learners grasp strategic HR concepts and translate them into practical, usable skills that can immediately be put to work. AIHR courses are on-demand, self-paced, and 100% online so that your team can easily build new skills, refresh existing expertise, and stay up to date with HR trends and developments – any time, anywhere.


While we pride ourselves on the quality of our courses, our aim is to offer everything you need to hit your objectives.


On top of advisory, we can support the deployment of targeted, structured learning journeys, peer-to-peer collaboration, guides and templates, and flexible learning formats help your team gain experience, sustain momentum, and develop the confidence to use new skills on the job to deliver business impact.

But not anymore. As a leader, you can now offer your HR team a self-paced training platform that evolves with their needs and ambitions.


Your HR team won’t just keep pace—they’ll grow alongside your organization.


Don’t Lose Top Performers. Inspire Them.


Top talent knows that continuous learning fuels career growth.

When that growth stalls, engagement drops, and you risk losing them altogether.


Creating a culture of learning within your HR team starts by giving employees access to trusted, relevant upskilling content they’ll actually want to engage with.


We facilitate this by helping you retain top talent across all HR functions, keeping critical knowledge in-house and building a strong, standout EVP.


Effortless, Practical, On-the-Job, HR Support.


Career growth happens every day, on the job, in the flow of work.

But as a leader balancing stakeholder expectations, strategic priorities, and performance management, there’s often little time left for proper support and coaching.


The AIHR platform can help by giving your team access to practical templates that save time, instant answers to complex questions through our HR-specialized AI Copilot, and inspiration from real-life HR challenges discussed in our community forums.

What makes AIHR different from others?






AIHR isn’t just an online academy — it’s a complete HR upskilling platform built for real-world impact.


We combine structured, hands-on learning journeys with powerful tools like a practical resource library, live expert events, an engaged global community, and bite-sized content that fits into the flow of work.


This means your team doesn’t just learn—they apply new skills immediately, get support when it matters most, and stay ahead of the curve with the latest HR trends and practices.










What kind of support will my team get?






Your team license includes three levels of support:


A dedicated Learning Consultant (for teams of 10+)

To help you drive adoption and achieve measurable business impact. They’ll ensure you and your team are set up for success and aligned with your learning goals. Upon request, your Learning Consultant will schedule a kickoff session for you and your team.


Personal Learning Coaches for each team member

These coaches help individuals design their learning journeys, stay accountable, and make progress aligned with their career goals.


Access to the AIHR Community

Join over 50,000 HR professionals and subject matter experts to get input, feedback, and inspiration on real-world HR challenges.










Does each user get access to all programs?






Yes! Every team member gets unlimited access to the full AIHR curriculum—including all courses, Certificate Programs, resources, coaching, and our global HR community.


They are also get access to all future course and Certificate Program releases.

Prepare HR to Thrive in the AI Era
The pace of change is accelerating. From tools like ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot to AI-powered features in HRIS and productivity platforms, automation is everywhere. Yet HR is often the last to benefit, risking efficiency, influence, and relevance as AI adoption advances across the organization.
 


Strategic AI Expertise for HR
Build the expertise to define your AI roadmap, governance, and ethics, aligning every use case with business priorities.
Leverage Existing Digital Pillars
Integrate AI into your current tools to enhance workflows and decision-making without adding complexity.
Enable a Global Mindset Shift
Go beyond skills to spark curiosity, experimentation, and problem-solving that drives lasting transformation.


Implementing AI Is a Strategic HR Priority


Technology changes how we work, but adoption determines your organization’s future. HR must lead this shift, defining the roadmap, governance, and ethics to ensure AI drives real business value.




Independent HR Audit:
 Unsure how ready your HR team is to lead AI transformation? We assess HR’s current state and AI-readiness, benchmark against best practices, and deliver a clear action plan to accelerate progress.


AI Foundational Knowledge for HR:
 Equip your HR teams with essential AI literacy, analytics skills, and practical know-how. Throught argeted learning journeys, they’ll gain the confidence to leverage AI tools, automate workflows, and make data-driven decisions.


Board-ready deliverables:
  From readiness assessments to governance and change management, our advisory services help you craft and execute a strategic AI roadmap, complete with the deliverables and insights needed to align leaders and unlock value.




More Value, Without a Global Technology Shift


AI shouldn’t disrupt your tech ecosystem, it should empower it. We help you activate AI within your existing systems to enhance workflows, decision-making, and adoption without costly migrations or new platforms.




Bridge the gap between insight and action:
 Integrate AI where your teams already work to drive real-time impact.


Scale innovation with confidence:
 Build on your existing digital foundations instead of replacing them.


Empower seamless adoption:
 Equip teams to integrate AI into daily work and maximize existing investments, creating impact without complexity.




Build a Workforce That Thinks in Terms of Automation and Impact


For AI to create organization-wide value, employees must learn to recognize where automation drives efficiency and innovation. Starting with HR, move from a reactive to a proactive approach, shifting repetitive tasks to AI while upskilling teams from basic prompting to intelligent automation.




Tailored use cases:
 Leverage HR tickets and interactions as a knowledge base to build internal AI agents that draft replies, documents, and talk tracks — creating faster, smarter workflows.


Measurable savings:
 Develop company-specific, T-shaped capability models and dynamic learning profiles to guide HR upskilling through transformation and beyond.


Cross-functional alignment:
 Connect HR, IT, and business leaders to co-create AI initiatives that balance innovation with compliance and employee trust.

How can you help my AI transformation?






Many organizations know they need to transform HR for the AI era, but aren’t sure where to start. We begin with discovery sessions to assess your current state and clarify your options before committing to larger initiatives. From there, we recommend the right next steps, whether that’s refining strategy, building capabilities, developing skills, or leading a full transformation. Our goal is simple: to equip your HR team to achieve meaningful, measurable impact.










What is your approach?






Our approach is collaborative, data-driven, and grounded in real HR practice. We combine insights from our global community of professionals with proven methodologies to design solutions that are both innovative and actionable.










Who are your experts?






Our team is made up of seasoned HR professionals and subject matter experts from diverse backgrounds. They bring deep, real-world experience to every engagement — and you’ll work directly with them to achieve your HR transformation goals.


For more information about our experts, visit our 
HR Advisory Solution Page










How do I get my team started?






Getting started is simple. Reach out through our contact form or book a consultation, and our team will guide you through the next steps, from understanding your goals to shaping the right support for your organization.










How does AIHR compare to other HR consultancies or training providers?






AIHR is your all-in-one platform for unlocking a strategic mindset and accelerating execution excellence. And because no two organizations are the same, we meet your team where they are and support their learning journey based on the goals you set.


Our advisors are seasoned HR professionals with both strategic and C-level experience in global organizations – they’ve seen it all and have proven know-how in building successful people strategies with business impact at their core.


Content-wise, our certificate programs and courses combine theory with practice to help learners grasp strategic HR concepts and translate them into practical, usable skills that can immediately be put to work. AIHR courses are on-demand, self-paced, and 100% online so that your team can easily build new skills, refresh existing expertise, and stay up to date with HR trends and developments – any time, anywhere.


While we pride ourselves on the quality of our courses, our aim is to offer everything you need to hit your objectives.


On top of advisory, we can support the deployment of targeted, structured learning journeys, peer-to-peer collaboration, guides and templates, and flexible learning formats help your team gain experience, sustain momentum, and develop the confidence to use new skills on the job to deliver business impact.

Connect with the AIHR Expert Team
















Dr. Dieter Veldsman (PhD)


Chief HR Scientist








Dr Dieter Veldsman
 is AIHR’s Chief HR Scientist, as well as a Professor of Practice at the University of Johannesburg in HR and Organizational Behavior. A globally recognized expert in HR and organizational psychology, he has co-authored various books, and hosts the videocast The HR Dialogues.


















Erik van Vulpen


Founder and Dean








Erik van Vulpen
, AIHR’s Founder and Dean, has trained HR professionals and teams worldwide to use data and tech to achieve meaningful business outcomes and lasting organizational change. He also authors AIHR’s annual HR Trends Report and personally teaches several of AIHR’s certificate programs.


















Marna van der Merwe


Lead Subject Matter Expert








Dr Marna van der Merwe
, AIHR’s Lead Subject Matter Expert, is a published author on various HR topics, including HR impact, strategic talent management, employee experience, and HR skills. She is also a registered Organizational Psychologist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa.


















Annelise Pretorius


Psychometrics Assessments Expert








Annelise Pretorius
 is AIHR’s Psychometrics Assessments Expert. She works with AIHR clients to improve their HR function by assessing current capabilities and identifying development priorities. She is also a registered Independent Psychometrist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa.


















Suhail Ramkilawan


Senior Solutions Advisor








Suhail Ramkilawan
 is AIHR’s Senior Solutions Advisor, as well as a registered Psychometrist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa. He specializes in talent assessment, solution development, and strategic partnerships, and supports organizations in HR skills development and career progression.
